relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Twelve (71%) participants developed a typical IIH headache attack with migraine-like features after CGRP compared with three (18%) after placebo

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: The mean ICP remained unchanged, whereas ICP amplitude increased significantly after CGRP (P = 0.005).

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: A plausible explanation for our findings is a peripherally initiated mechanism in which CGRP-induced dilation of cranial arteries activates the trigeminovascular system.

key_findings: IV CGRP provoked migraine-like IIH headache in 71% vs 18% with placebo (P=0.004).
CGRP increased ICP pulse amplitude without altering mean ICP.
